ISO/CD 25785-1 covers industrial mobile robots that need active control to remain balanced, including bipedal machines <Cite id="iso-cd-25785-1" />. It is a committee draft: in late September 2026 the catalogue still showed stage 30.60, close of the comment period, with edition 1 unpublished <Cite id="iso-cd-25785-1" />. A parallel technical report for the United States and Canada, ANSI/A3 TR R15.108, is under development for dynamically stable industrial mobile robots including humanoids <Cite id="agility-digit-5-2026" />.
edits.after: A humanoid falls, a hazard class the industrial documents were not written for. ISO/CD 25785-1 covers industrial mobile robots that need active control to remain balanced, including bipedal machines <Cite id="iso-cd-25785-1" />. It is a committee draft: the comment period closed on 8 July 2026, and in late October 2026 the catalogue still showed stage 30.60, with edition 1 unpublished and no date for the next stage <Cite id="iso-cd-25785-1" />. A parallel technical report for the United States and Canada, ANSI/A3 TR R15.108, is under development for dynamically stable industrial mobile robots including humanoids <Cite id="agility-digit-5-2026" />.
